The Role

This is a highly technical, hands-on role for someone who thinks beyond traditional DevOps. You'll own infrastructure reliability, scalability, and observability while pushing toward a future where infrastructure increasingly manages itself through AI agents and intelligent automation.

You'll work across cloud infrastructure, deployment systems, monitoring, security, and incident response, building the tools and workflows that allow a small engineering team to move exceptionally fast without compromising reliability.

We're looking for someone who has operated complex production systems, understands infrastructure at a deep level, and is already using AI coding agents to fundamentally change how engineering work gets done.

  1. Build agentic infrastructure: Design and implement AI-powered workflows for infrastructure provisioning, deployments, monitoring, incident detection, and automated remediation.

  3. Make systems observable: Build comprehensive logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting systems that provide actionable visibility into production health.

  5. Own infrastructure lifecycle management: Drive cloud security hygiene, dependency upgrades, runtime migrations, and infrastructure modernization from design through production.

data.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a strategic Mainframe Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end architectural design, integration, and modernization roadmap of our mission-critical IBM Z enterprise systems. In this role, you will bridge core legacy platforms with modern distributed and cloud ecosystems, ensuring scalability, high availability, security, and alignment with long-term business objectives.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and govern end-to-end technical architectures across mainframe (z/OS) and hybrid cloud/distributed environments.

  • Lead solution design for core system enhancements, API enablement, data replication, and legacy modernization initiatives.

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, and engineering leads to translate complex functional requirements into scalable architectural blueprints.

  • Evaluate and recommend modernization patterns (e.g., API wrapping, refactoring, co-existence, or rehosting) while minimizing operational risk and downtime.

  • Establish non-functional requirements covering transaction throughput, disaster recovery, security compliance, and high availability.

  • Provide architectural oversight, technical mentorship, and design reviews for onshore and offshore mainframe development teams.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 10+ years of experience in mainframe engineering, with at least 3+ years in a Solution Architect or Principal Technical Lead capacity.

  • Comprehensive mastery of the IBM z/OS ecosystem, including COBOL, JCL, DB2, CICS, VSAM, and IBM MQ.

  • Proven track record architecting hybrid integrations between mainframe backends and modern distributed/cloud platforms (REST APIs, microservices, Kafka).

  • Strong understanding of enterprise security, data privacy, and regulatory compliance standards in banking or financial services.

  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills with the ability to present complex architectural trade-offs to both technical and executive audiences.

Technical Depth

  • Deep architectural knowledge of high-volume online transaction processing (CICS/IMS) and large-scale batch processing patterns.

  • Hands-on familiarity with integration and modernization middleware such as IBM z/OS Connect, MQSeries, CDC (Change Data Capture), or API gateways.

  • Strong grasp of database architecture, capacity planning, and system-level performance optimization on DB2 for z/OS.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and mainframe-to-cloud migration or re-platforming projects.

  • Familiarity with modern mainframe DevOps toolchains (Git, Jenkins, IBM Developer for z/OS, SonarQube).

  • Relevant architectural certifications (e.g., TOGAF, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect, or IBM Z certifications).

data.description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote), United States (Remote), United Kingdom (Remote) Mexico City, Mexico - Hybrid

About CircleCI Engineering

CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.

At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.

Team-Agnostic Placement

We don't hire for a team. We hire for CircleCI. Where you land depends on where your strengths create the most leverage, and we figure that out together. You might own the CI pipeline experience, deploy and release tooling, notification infrastructure, monetization flows, AI agent surfaces, or the foundational web platform. The through line across all of it is the same: full-stack ownership, a high bar for craft, and work that directly shapes how tens of thousands of developers experience CircleCI every day.

What You'll Do

  • Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved.
  • Own technical strategy for your domain. You decide when and how the architecture evolves, balancing technical debt against velocity. When a project spans teams, you're the one who breaks down the ambiguity and takes ownership of whether it lands.
  • Invent new interfaces. Software delivery is being reinvented. Pipelines run autonomously, generate fixes, and surface results that need human judgment. The tools developers use to understand, trust, and act on that work don't exist yet. You'll define what they look like and establish the patterns the team builds on.
  • Own the full stack, at scale. Build features end-to-end in Go, React, and TypeScript. Your ownership extends past your own code to the systems and teams around it.
  • Connect engineering to the business. Partner directly with Product and Engineering Management to translate business goals into technical strategy. You understand the "why" behind the roadmap and use it to make tradeoffs.
  • Champion observability. Drive monitoring and alerting strategy across your domain, not just your own services. Use Honeycomb, Datadog, and Rollbar to reduce noise and improve the org's ability to diagnose problems quickly.
  • Mentor at scale. Mentor multiple engineers at once. Build the systems and documentation that transfer knowledge and remove single points of failure, not just your own.

What You'll Bring

  • AI-native engineering practices. You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short.
  • A track record of shipping at scale. You've built and owned systems that other engineers build on. 8+ years of production full-stack experience, with a history of taking accountability for outcomes.
  • Full-stack depth. Strong across the stack — React and TypeScript on the frontend, Go on the backend, owning API design, data modeling, and service integration.
  • System design, across domains. You own architecture decisions that span multiple systems and teams. You make the tradeoff calls, document the reasoning, and are the person others escalate to when the answer isn't obvious.
  • Business acumen. You understand how your domain connects to the broader business, and you use that context to guide technical decisions, not just implement them.
  • Technical leadership. You mentor engineers, give direct feedback on technical direction, and raise the quality bar across teams through how you engage in reviews and design discussions, not just what you ship.

Sound like you?

You've stopped waiting for AI to mature and are already building with it, not as a productivity trick, but as a core part of how you think about problems. You care about the product as much as the code. You're drawn to work where the patterns don't exist yet and the best answer requires you to invent it. If that's how you already operate, we want to talk.

About CircleCI

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital. 

CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring

At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

Where we may use AI

  • Job descriptions and messaging: AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.
  • Application review: For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications. 
  • Interview notes: With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected.
  • Outreach: AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending.

Our commitment

AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change.

Your choices

You can ask for human-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact recruiting@circleci.com.  For how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

experience_requirements.text: 4+ years of experience in application security or security engineering roles

data.description:
Headquarters: Remote - US: Select locations

Role Description

As part of the Product Security Engineering team, you’ll focus on reducing risk at scale by building the security infrastructure, automation, and tooling that empowers engineers to ship secure products with confidence. We work closely with engineering and product teams throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), embedding secure-by-default practices and delivering scalable solutions.

Product Security Engineers create impact by implementing security tooling, writing custom security rules, and building frameworks that address broad classes of vulnerabilities. In addition to proactive development, we support teams through threat modeling, documentation, and education to uplift security culture across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain security tools, automation, and libraries to enable secure-by-default development across engineering teams.
  • Design and implement custom security rules (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL) to detect and prevent common and emerging vulnerability patterns.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on application security across web, mobile, and desktop environments.
  • Improve and scale the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) by integrating tools, checks, and processes into engineering workflows.
  • Perform targeted code reviews, and develop follow-up tooling or controls to prevent regressions.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, GRC, and AI/ML teams to proactively address security risks, especially in fast-moving and emerging tech areas.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in application security or security engineering roles.
  • Hands-on experience building or using security automation tools to improve developer workflows and product security.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across the SDLC, including supporting and interpreting findings from penetration tests and bug bounty reports.
  • Familiarity with modern tech stacks, including microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native environments.
  • Solid understanding of common vulnerability classes (e.g., injection, XSS, authN/authZ issues) and practical mitigation strategies.
  • Comfortable working in cross-functional environments and supporting multiple product and engineering teams simultaneously.
  • Experience participating in or supporting incident response or security on-call rotations is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in application security engineering, with a strong focus on security tooling and automation.
  • Demonstrated ability to write and maintain custom security rules and integrate them into developer workflows.
  • Experience with machine learning systems, particularly generative AI, and the ability to support secure development in AI-driven products.
  • Experience developing internal libraries or frameworks that reduce or eliminate entire classes of vulnerabilities.
  • Proficient in software development, with experience contributing production-level code in one or more modern languages.
  • Familiarity with securing diverse application types, including web, mobile, and native platforms.
  • Experience with data security, including tooling for data protection, access control, and encryption.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to build trusted partnerships with cross-functional teams.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

This role is not available in Zone 1

data.title: Senior Manager, Platform Security
data.description:
Headquarters: New York, New York; Miami, Florida; Remote (USA)

About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Platform Security

In the emerging industry of digital assets, there is nothing more important than trust. The Gemini security team forms the backbone of trust. In fact, Gemini’s very first hires were security specialists and we continue to tackle unique challenges in the crypto space.  Our team ensures that our customers, clients, and employees are safe, secure, and supported.

The Role: Senior Manager, Platform Security

Gemini takes a cloud-first approach to our services, platforms, and vendors, allowing the organization to continue scaling with hypergrowth hiring, innovative product development, and demanding customer needs. To achieve that scale securely, Gemini has a dedicated Platform Security team whose mission is to enable the business to achieve secure-by-design architectures, implement best-in-class security technologies, and help our engineering partners to achieve security success easily & confidently. To further that mission, we’re looking for a new leader to join the existing team to take our vision, strategy, internal partnerships, business alignment, & technical expertise to the next stage of maturity. At Gemini, our best leaders lead from the trenches — we need this Senior Manager to remain hands-on, spending a meaningful portion of their time in the code, IaC, and architecture diagrams alongside their team — writing Terraform, reviewing PRs, and prototyping solutions, not just unblocking others when they're stuck.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic and technical leadership of Gemini's Platform Security team, personally architecting and implementing security solutions alongside engineers — including writing and reviewing Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and security tooling code
  • Align team-wide strategy with the needs of the business, internal partners, & peer Security leadership
  • Enable the ongoing success & growth of the team through creation of hiring plans and hands-on technical mentorship — pairing with engineers, reviewing designs and PRs, and staying current on the team's actual codebase
  • Establish a Platform Security roadmap for initiatives that will provide ever-increasing maturity of capabilities for stakeholders, while also reducing toil through automation
  • Serve as a senior technical escalation point for the team's hardest architecture and engineering problems, contributing working code/IaC when the situation calls for it
  • Foster trust-centric relationships with key partner teams, ensuring that their voices are heard and needs are being met, while achieving excellent security outcomes together
  • Lead the development of security policies, procedures, standards, & guidelines that will guide functional security outcomes with all GRC and Audits needs being met
  • Determine program KPIs that will meaningfully highlight where we’re succeeding, or falling short of, the mission we aim to accomplish for the business
  • Provide guidance through lived-experience and industry awareness on the different approaches to architecture, security engineering, and business-achievement goals
  • Define a customer-first process, choosing to provide self-service solutions that minimize friction, create agility, and provide value-oriented ways to solve problems
  • Manage relevant third-party vendor relationships, leading the determination of when & why to “build” vs. “buy” in response to gaps in capabilities the business may have

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of leadership experience for cloud-native engineering and/or security teams, with a strong preference for Amazon Web Services (AWS)-based organizations
  • 10+ years of direct, technical experience in relevant roles (e.g., Platform Engineering, Security), with continued hands-on coding/IaC work within the last 2-3 years — not solely past practitioner experience
  • Strong experience in AWS, EKS (Kubernetes), IAM, Terraform, GitHub Enterprise Cloud
  • Experience leveraging industry security frameworks & standards that act as the basis of maturing the overall security program and enable successful business outcomes
  • Comfortable with hiring & scaling a team 
  • Prior success in leading a team through organizational change management, with a strong preference for start-up experience in a technology-centric business
  • Able to easily communicate with technical stakeholders at their level, hearing their feedback and translating those needs or concerns into program-level outcomes
  • Pragmatic about security requirements, ignoring “best practices” that don’t make sense to the needs of the business by leveraging your team’s expertise for decision making
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with an attention to detail

It Pays to Work Here

The compensation & benefits package for this role includes:

  • Competitive starting pay
  • A discretionary annual bonus
  • Long-term incentive in the form of a new hire equity grant
  • Comprehensive health plans
  • 401K with company matching
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible time off

Salary Range: The base salary range for this role is between $195,000 - $300,000 in the State of New York. This range is not inclusive of our discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data.

In the United States, we offer a hybrid work approach at our hub offices, balancing the benefits of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Expectations may vary by location and role, so candidates are encouraged to connect with their recruiter to learn more about the specific policy for the role. Employees who do not live near one of our hubs are part of our remote workforce. All employees, however, are required to onboard in-person at one of our office locations.

At Gemini, we strive to build diverse teams that reflect the people we want to empower through our products, and we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Equal Opportunity is the Law, and Gemini is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. If you have a specific need that requires accommodation, please let a member of the People Team know.

Basic Function

The Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Manager provides leadership and strategic oversight for the SRE function, ensuring operational excellence, incident preparedness, and system reliability across the organization. This role is responsible for capacity management, budget planning, and policy adherence, as well as guiding the team through critical events and audits. The SRE Manager champions key performance metrics such as uptime and SLA compliance, and fosters a healthy, high-performing team culture through mentorship, alignment with company values, and career development. This role reports to the VP of SRE and helps align SRE initiatives with organizational priorities.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic leadership to the SRE team, ensuring high engagement, operational alignment, and execution of meaningful, value-driven work.

  • Serve as incident commander during critical and disaster recovery events, ensuring coordination, communication, and rapid resolution.

  • Oversee policy compliance and audit readiness, ensuring the SRE team adheres to internal standards and regulatory obligations.

  • Track, analyze, and report SRE performance metrics (e.g., SLAs, uptime, error budgets) to the Senior Leadership Team (SLT) for transparency and improvement.

  • Collaborate with the VP of SRE to define and manage the annual operating budget, balancing cost efficiency with system reliability.

  • Evaluate and prioritize incoming workstreams, ensuring projects align with broader organizational goals and drive long-term sustainability and innovation.

  • Partner cross-functionally with engineering, security, and product teams to ensure the successful delivery of SRE initiatives.

  • Champion professional development, promoting team growth through mentorship, feedback, and career pathing.

  • Drive a culture of operational excellence, encouraging automation, process improvement, and continuous learning across the team.

  • Other duties as assigned

  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision

  • Ability to occasionally lift/move up to 25 pounds

  • Individuals with a disability who are otherwise able to perform the essential functions of the job may request reasonable accommodation through the Human Resources department.

  • Other physical activities may be required to support business operations.

  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions) and a track record of driving automation to reduce toil.

  • Experience with disaster recovery and business continuity planning, including testing and documenting recovery procedures.

  • Experience supporting audits and compliance requirements (e.g., SOC 2, PCI DSS) in a regulated or security-conscious environment.

  • Experience managing or contributing to an operating budget and capacity planning for cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience partnering with engineering, security, and product teams to align reliability work with business outcomes.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

Senior Support Engineer

Team: Customer Engineering and Success, CircleCI

About the team

Support Engineering is part of Customer Engineering and Success at CircleCI. We give technical support to customers after they buy. Our team works around the clock across North America, Asia Pacific, and Europe.

We build and manage AI agents that answer customer questions and solve technical problems. People step in when a problem needs deeper work. We also share what we learn with Product and Engineering to make CircleCI better.

About the role

Senior Support Engineers take on the hardest customer problems and incidents. You help set how our AI support agents handle those problems, and you step in when agents cannot. You also mentor teammates and help the team grow its skills.

You use AI tools every day. You check all AI output, and you help others on the team do the same.

What you will do

  • Design, build, and improve AI support agents. Measure how well they work.
  • Own the hardest customer problems from start to finish, including those agents cannot solve.
  • Lead the team during incidents. Keep customers informed with clear and timely updates.
  • Review AI-assisted work from teammates and coach them.
  • Mentor teammates. Share what you know so that no single person is the only expert.
  • Check new product features for how easy they will be to support. Work with Product and Engineering to fix problems early.
  • Set team goals. Improve team processes and help content.
  • Advocate for customer experience with Product and Engineering.
  • Meet response targets on the cases you own.
  • You describe what the product can and cannot do. We do not oversell.
  • Join the on-call rotation.

What you need

  • More than 3 years in technical product support or software engineering. You have solved complex problems.
  • Hands-on experience building or running AI tools, workflows, or agents. You review results for accuracy.
  • Skill at tracing failures across services in cloud or distributed systems. You read logs and test ideas to find the cause.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. You have used tools like kubectl to find why an application or cluster is failing.
  • Experience supporting self-hosted or on-premises software. You have used tools like Helm and support bundles to find why an installation is failing.
  • Hands-on experience with build, test, and deploy automation. You have written automated tests and set up a CI/CD pipeline for a project.
  • Experience running self-hosted build runners on Linux, Windows, macOS, or Arm, including in networks with limited access.
  • Experience with SDLC practices and related tooling; infrastructure as code (such as Terraform), CI/CD, Git, and Linux.
  • Experience working with API programmatically, scripting against them with a CLI or SDK.
  • You can write scripts to reproduce problems.
  • Knowledge of networking and security.
  • Experience troubleshooting single sign-on (SSO), OAuth, and access controls. You have worked with identity providers and code-hosting sign-in.

How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring

At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

Where we may use AI

  • Job descriptions and messaging: AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.
  • Application review: For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications.

AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

  • We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
  • We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
  • We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
  • We're an international, diverse team of over 200 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world

  • We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
  • We’ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
  • We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world

About The Role

CoverGo is hiring an Application Security Engineer to use AI to find and prevent vulnerabilities before they reach production, and to give engineering teams the tools and guardrails that stop vulnerabilities from being introduced in the first place. The Security team is small and growing, and works AI-first: everyone uses AI to automate their own work and to scale security across a large engineering organisation.

What You Will Do

  • Use AI tools such as Claude and OpenAI models to find and triage vulnerabilities in code, dependencies and designs before changes are merged.
  • Embed security checks into developer workflows and CI/CD pipelines so issues surface as code is written.
  • Select, configure and tune code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk and Checkmarx, keeping the signal high enough that engineers act on the findings.
  • Build self-service tools, guardrails and guidance that help engineering teams prevent common vulnerability classes.
  • Partner with engineering leads and security champions across product teams to prioritise and fix findings.
  • Review security-relevant designs and changes, ranking risk by what an attacker could realistically reach.
  • Track and report on application-security risk and remediation progress.

What We Need

  • 3+ years in application security or a closely related security role.
  • An AI-native approach to securing software: you already use LLMs to find, detect and explain vulnerabilities.
  • Enough fluency in at least one modern programming language to read, understand and fix vulnerable code. A software-engineering background is not required.
  • Hands-on experience with code-security tools such as GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk or Checkmarx.
  • A solid grasp of common vulnerability classes, such as the OWASP Top 10, and how to prevent them.
  • A practical, enabling style of working with engineers.

Nice to have

  • Experience building custom security tooling or automations on LLM APIs.
  • Experience securing applications on AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated SaaS environment.

  • Health Insurance

You will consistently rely on your knowledge of production support and your background in dev-ops processes, including incident/change/problem management, call triaging, and critical issue resolution procedures. You will collaborate with our customers, internal teams, architects, and Site Reliability Engineering teams to troubleshoot complex and challenging issues.

This position extends well beyond product support as you will be a trusted partner to our enterprise customers by offering developer-to-developer assistance for cloud-native service development and architecture; you will work closely with junior and senior engineers and developers, fixing and improving code and identifying automation opportunities.

You'll partner closely with development engineering teams and work alongside some of the brightest developers in the open source community. You will also work with Red Hat’s key strategic cloud partners to jointly solve customer Multi-Cloud issues.

What you will do:

  • Support Red Hat’s customers using our OpenShift Ecosystem running on different Hybrid Cloud solutions (public providers including Azure, AWS, Google and also on premise deployments)
  • Actively support and provide guidance to other Red Hat engineers dealing with more complex issues
  • Resolve Red Hat’s customers issues across different components such as Logging (Elasticsearch, FluentD, Kibana), Monitoring, Networking (SDN / OVN kubernetes), Storage, Service Mesh/Istio
  • Be a regional / global subject matter expert on one of the above mentioned OpenShift components

  • Build on your expertise by going through intensive onboarding, which includes taking RHEL and Openshift Certifications, such as Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE), Containers & Kubernetes (DO180)/Operating a Production Kubernetes Cluster (DO280), Scaling Kubernetes Deployments in the Enterprise (DO380)
  • Consult the customer cases with in-house support engineers and developers to promote creative solutions and improve customer experience
  • Contribute to the global Red Hat knowledge management system
  • As a part of your professional development, you can collaborate with your colleagues on different projects outside of your day to day work, contribute to the success of the global team and / or contribute to OpenSource community and product code

What you will bring:

  • Previous experience configuring and troubleshooting OpenShift or Kubernetes and one of its components such as (Logging, Monitoring, Networking, Storage, Service Mesh)

data.title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we’ve built an AI-powered platform that changes how pharmaceutical companies and doctors around the world collaborate to bring medical breakthroughs to patients. Leading companies and over 5,500 research sites rely on Inato to increase patient access, improve representation in trials, and deliver life-changing treatments to patients faster.

Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research.

Inato is a recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025 and 2026.

The Role

As our Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer, you will own the maintainability and scalability of the infrastructure that powers Inato's platform. Reporting to Bastien, our CTO, you will split your time between projects that strengthen our infrastructure and run work that keeps it healthy.

Until now, infrastructure work has been a shared responsibility between all members of the tech department. Now that we have multiples teams, more complex services, and a rapidly growing volume of patient data and system integrations, we believe it's time for a dedicated position. This is a high-ownership, senior individual-contributor role: you will inherit a functioning system, and be responsible for bringing it to the next level.

Your success will be measured by the impact of your projects on product delivery, and your ability to prevent and solve production issues.

Responsibilities

  • Lead projects that improve the maintainability and scalability of our cloud infrastructure

  • Own day-to-day infrastructure operations, solving problems directly or making sure they are dispatched to the right team

  • Coach other tech team members on how to best leverage the capabilities of our cloud infrastructure

Qualifications

Must-have

  • 5+ years in a similar role (infrastructure, platform, SRE, DevOps)

  • Strong experience building and maintaining highly available cloud infrastructure environments using code, directly supporting product delivery

  • Deep understanding of Linux systems, containerization and orchestration

  • Solid networking fundamentals

  • Excellent communication, able to translate between technical and non-technical audiences

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with GCP

  • Experience as the first or sole dedicated infrastructure hire

  • Experience in a regulated or healthcare environment

Concrete project examples

  • Redesign our IAM model. Move us from ad-hoc, hand-managed permissions to a clean least-privilege structure managed as code, making access auditable, consistent, and easy to reason about as we scale.

  • Centralize our logging. Re-architect how we handle logs so everything flows into a single dedicated sink project, giving the team one reliable place to observe and debug across environments.

  • Bring our cloud costs under control. Build cost visibility and guardrails into our GCP footprint, surfacing waste, setting budgets and alerting, and making cost a first-class signal in how we run infrastructure.

Technical environment

  • Cloud: GCP, GKE, Cloud Run

  • Infrastructure-as-Code: Terraform

  • CI/CD: GitHub, GitHub Actions

  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, Axiom

We are looking for a candidate who will be responsible for the build system and build infrastructure of a large, complex software product — from compiling and packaging hundreds of interdependent components to assembling, signing and publishing the artifacts we release — and for making the build fast, reproducible and trustworthy for everyone who depends on it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO  

  • Own, design and evolve the build system for a product assembled from a large number of interdependent components written in several programming languages.
  • Build and maintain the build pipelines end to end: isolated and reproducible builds, dependency and version management, build agents and build farms, artifact repositories and caching — and keep build times, success rates and reproducibility under control as the product grows.
  • Assemble and validate release deliverables: packages, images and installation artifacts, and the repositories they are distributed from, for several supported release lines maintained in parallel.
  • Build and operate the release pipeline: automated build validation and regression gating, artifact signing, promotion between channels, and the publishing and rollback procedures around a release.
  • Keep the product buildable through toolchain and dependency upgrades: resolve compiler, library and dependency conflicts, and keep build definitions and downstream patches maintainable instead of accumulating.
  • Maintain traceability of everything we ship: versioning and changelogs, artifact provenance, license and SBOM data, and the integration points that security scanning and audits rely on.
  • Automate build tooling, release steps and the provisioning of build environments in Python and shell, and integrate the build with the team's source control, review and issue tracking workflows.
  • Support developers and QA day to day: fast self-service builds of branches and merge requests, quick diagnosis of build and packaging failures, and unblocking people whose work is stuck behind the build.
  • Extend CI/CD coverage: validation on every commit, promotion of artifacts between environments, and integration of automated test suites into release gating.
  • Own the build infrastructure itself — build hosts and builder images, artifact storage, capacity planning — working with IT and operations where infrastructure is shared.
  • Investigate complex and intermittent build failures and drive them from root cause to a permanent fix rather than a retry.
  • Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools for development, code and log analysis, debugging, root-cause investigation and technical research.
  • Document the build and release processes so that they are reproducible by someone else, and share that expertise with the development and QA teams.
  • Maintain clear communication with the development lead on build and release status, risks, dependencies and critical issues.


WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years in build, release or DevOps engineering for complex software products, including ownership of a build system as a whole and not only of individual CI jobs.
  • Strong CI/CD engineering: Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or comparable; pipelines as code, build agents, and artifact repositories.
  • Solid experience with software packaging and the distribution of binary artifacts on Linux, including artifact signing and repository or channel management.
  • Ability to read, fix and take over build definitions written by other teams across multiple languages and build tools (make, CMake, autotools, and language-native build and packaging tooling).
  • Deep understanding of dependency and version management, reproducible and hermetic builds, incremental builds and build caching.
  • Solid Python and shell scripting for build tooling and release automation.
  • Strong Linux systems knowledge, plus containers and configuration management tooling.
  • Confident with Git and with branching and release models in a product that maintains several releases at once.
  • Experience delivering updates to already installed software — channels, staged rollout, acceptance and rollback — is a strong advantage.
  • Familiarity with software supply chain practices: signing, SBOM, dependency and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience scaling a build system — parallelism, distributed builds, cutting build times from hours to minutes — is a strong advantage.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, and the patience to take over a large inherited build system with incomplete documentation.
  • AI-assisted engineering experience is mandatory, including practical use of AI for development, debugging, log analysis, investigation and technical research.
  • Demonstrated ability to treat the build as a product that the rest of engineering depends on, and to share technical expertise across teams.
  • Excellent English communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

*Please submit your resume and application in English 

WHO WE ARE

A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is usd by over 21,000 service providers to protect more than 750,000 businesses. 

Our corporate culture centers on innovation, accountability, and impact. We encourage our people to think boldly, challenge conventional approaches, and take ownership of outcomes. As a member of our global “A-Team,” you’ll operate in a high-growth, fast-paced environment where resilience, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement drive success.

OUR INTERVIEW PRACTICES

To ensure a fair and genuine hiring process, candidates are expected to participate in interviews without the use of AI tools, automated prompts, or third-party assistance. Interviews are designed to assess individual skills, experience, and communication style, and we value authentic, real-time interaction.

Use of AI or external assistance during live interviews may result in disqualification. For roles where AI skills are being evaluated, permitted use of AI tools will be clearly communicated in advance. Candidates may be asked to disable virtual backgrounds or participate in in-person interviews. All employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of applicable criminal, education and identity background checks

Acronis is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

The US pay range for this position is $123,000–$160,000. This range reflects the minimum and maximum total target annual compensation for this role across all U.S. locations. The actual compensation offered at the start of employment is determined based on factors including, but not limited to, experience level, knowledge, skills, and geographic location.

In addition to competitive compensation, this role includes a comprehensive benefits package featuring medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible spending accounts (FSA), disability and life insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan with company match, and a generous vacation policy.

data.description:
Headquarters: Czechia
URL: http://bloomreach.com

Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.

  • We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
  • We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
  • We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

Are you looking for a cutting-edge tech stack to work with daily? We are currently expanding our Infrastructure team and are looking for a new colleague to join as a Staff DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer. You can work from home or one of our Central Europe offices (Bratislava, Brno, Prague) on a full-time basis. The base salary range for this position is 1 520 000 - 1 900 000 CZK. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Are you ready to grow with us?

What tech stack do we have for you?

  • Kubernetes (GKE), Terraform, GitLab
  • Google Cloud, including a wide range of managed products such as Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Bigtable, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub
  • Self-hosted stack: MongoDB, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Etcd, Victoria Metrics, InfluxDB, Sentry
  • Python, Golang

Minimum requirements:

At least 5 years of production experience with:

  • Kubernetes - we are looking for an engineer who not only deploys applications to a cluster, but also understands what is happening behind the scenes and can operate 24x7 production
  • GCP (preferred)/AWS/Azure - our solution is built on top of the GCP platform. Candidate should be comfortable working with public cloud, understand the risks and benefits associated with running applications in the public cloud, be familiar with infrastructure as a code principle, and have the ability to make design choices between using cloud-managed solutions versus self-hosted alternatives
  • Python/Go - you should be able to read and understand code with confidence, and to review and evaluate AI-generated Python code for correctness, security, and fit. Hands-on coding skills matter less than before, but you should still be able to develop custom tooling when needed, with or without AI assistance

If you don’t meet these requirements, don’t worry; take a look at the Senior DevOps position - Czechia: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/bloomreach/jobs/8329244, Slovakia: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/bloomreach/jobs/8329243

How to know if you are a good fit:

The qualifications outlined below serve as a guide to determine if your skills and experience align with the requirements of this position:

  • Design and Specification: You turn loosely defined problems into designs and specifications that others can execute. You write design proposals, weigh trade-offs between managed and self-hosted solutions, and review the designs of others.
  • Cross-team Leadership: You have led projects spanning multiple teams, from scoping and planning through delivery, coordinating engineers who do not report to you.
  • Independent Delivery: You take a specified maintenance or project task and drive it to completion on your own. AI assistants are a given part of your toolkit, but you always understand and can explain how and why every change was made.
  • AI as a Tool, Not a Replacement: You use AI assistants to work faster, not to hand your work over. You understand what the AI produced, question and verify it, and steer it toward the outcome you want rather than accepting whatever it gives you. You stay in control and remain accountable for everything you ship.
  • Continuous Learning: You have a keen interest in Kubernetes and related technologies, as demonstrated by your active engagement in reading and staying up to date on them.
  • Conference Participation: You have participated in DevOps-related conferences, showcasing your commitment to continuous learning and networking in the field.
  • Configuration Proficiency: You have hands-on experience configuring pod/container security context, network policies, roles and role bindings, pod affinity, host path, pod disruption budgets, priority classes, node taints, to name a few.
  • Resource Optimization: You have analyzed resource usage of applications hosted on a cluster and implemented or suggested changes to resource requests/limits, Horizontal Pod Autoscalers (HPAs), or Vertical Pod Autoscalers (VPAs).
  • Cluster Management: You have a deep understanding of the clusters you manage, including the types of machines used in node pools, the reasons for their selection, which cluster features are enabled or disabled, the cluster version, and the node autoscaling configuration. You have successfully upgraded the Kubernetes cluster versions without interrupting live applications hosted on the cluster.
  • Terraform Proficiency: You have written a Terraform module with multiple interconnected resources.
  • Monitoring and Alerting: You have experience setting up monitoring systems and configuring alerts. On-duty experience is preferred, along with experience with Grafana and Prometheus.
  • DevOps and CI/CD Experience: You have experience with DevOps, Orchestration/Configuration Management, and Continuous Integration technologies, including Terraform, GitLab, Ansible, and Docker.
  • Team Onboarding and Training: You have experience with onboarding and training new team members, demonstrating your leadership skills and commitment to team growth.

About your team:

The Infrastructure team operates and maintains Bloomreach Engagement core infrastructure built on Google Cloud with security, high availability, costs, and scalability in mind. Our vision is to identify and implement opportunities to achieve a robust, reliable, and efficient infrastructure and development platform. We strongly support DevOps culture: each team is responsible for releasing, operating, and monitoring their own applications.

The role of the Infrastructure Team is to provide a strong foundation upon which all teams can build, for example, manage big infrastructure components like Kubernetes, databases, and cloud components in Google Cloud. An important role of the team is also to provide support to developers, review design proposals, validate the performance and availability of applications, and sometimes even develop new core application components such as logging or authorization.

Tasks and responsibilities:

In the position of Staff DevOps Engineer, you’d be expected to work with other Engineering teams to design sustainable infrastructure, microservice solutions, and an efficient and robust production environment. Additionally, you’ll be working on a variety of tasks and projects, including automating tools and infrastructure to reduce manual work, monitoring applications and participating in an on-call rotation as required.

You’ll own the design and specification of infrastructure initiatives, break them down into tasks the team can execute, and lead projects that span multiple engineering teams. AI assistants are a given part of your toolkit, and you retain full understanding of, and responsibility for, what gets shipped.

The ideal candidate will be passionate about learning new things, creative, willing to take the initiative, and able to think outside the box to solve problems strategically.

#LI-KP1

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

  • A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. 

  • We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. 

  • We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.

  • We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.

  • We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.

  • We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.

  • The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

Personal Development:

  • We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions.

  • Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.*

  • Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins.

  • Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)*

Well-being:

  • The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.*

  • Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.*

  • We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.

  • We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.

  • Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.*

Compensation:

  • Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.*

  • We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!

  • We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!*

(*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)

Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!

If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful!

Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees.

Description

We are looking for a Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer to develop and operate GoMining's cloud platform.

The primary focus of this role is GCP and Kubernetes, infrastructure and application delivery automation, and the reliability and security of production services.

You will maintain and improve our existing infrastructure, contribute to the development of the next generation of our platform, and help product teams ship changes safely and efficiently.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and operate infrastructure in GCP, including GKE, virtual machines, networking, load balancers, storage, and managed services.
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code with Terraform: develop modules, manage state and dependencies, ensure reproducible changes, and identify configuration drift.
  • Operate Kubernetes: upgrade clusters and platform components, configure autoscaling, workload placement, network policies, and resource allocation.
  • Develop CI/CD and GitOps using GitLab CI and Flux / Argo CD, automating builds, checks, deployments, controlled releases, and rollbacks.
  • Build observability across metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and actionable alerting. Define and improve SLIs/SLOstogether with engineering teams.
  • Troubleshoot production incidents and performance issues, conduct root cause analysis, and eliminate recurring failure patterns.
  • Implement least-privilege access, environment and service isolation, secure secrets management and rotation, and infrastructure audit controls.
  • Maintain backup processes and regularly validate recovery of critical data and infrastructure according to agreed RPO/RTO.
  • Help engineering teams prepare services for production, including health checks, resource configuration, telemetry, and deployment procedures.
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure usage and costs while maintaining reliability requirements.
  • Maintain infrastructure documentation, operational runbooks, and recovery procedures.



Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience independently operating production infrastructure and Kubernetes, including upgrades, troubleshooting, and disaster recovery.
  • Strong experience with GCP, including GKE, Compute Engine, VPC, IAM, and Cloud Storage; good understanding of Cloud SQL, Cloud Logging, and Cloud Monitoring.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform, including modules, remote state, locking, importing existing resources, and safely applying infrastructure changes through CI.
  • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes and containerization: Deployments, StatefulSets, Services, Ingress, storage, requests/limits, probes, autoscaling, RBAC, and NetworkPolicy.
  • Experience with Helm and Kustomize.
  • Strong Linux administration skills, preferably Debian/Ubuntu: processes, systemd, filesystems, disks, and resource troubleshooting.
  • Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP(S), TLS, routing, NAT, load balancing, and firewalls.
  • Ability to troubleshoot connectivity issues across applications, Kubernetes clusters, networks, and cloud services.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines, preferably with GitLab CI, and strong understanding of Git and GitOps principles.
  • Understanding of runner permissions, secrets protection, and production deployment controls.
  • Automation skills with Bash and Python, including maintainable infrastructure scripts and API integrations.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Cloud Monitoring.
  • Practical experience operating PostgreSQL and understanding Redis and RabbitMQ, including availability, connections, replication or clustering, backup, and recovery.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security principles: least privilege, service accounts, Workload Identity, secrets management, network segmentation, and access auditing.
  • Ability to independently deliver infrastructure changes to a validated production result, explain technical trade-offs, and collaborate effectively with Engineering and Security teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Flux CD, Argo CD, Ansible, and HashiCorp Vault.
  • Experience with OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing.
  • Experience migrating infrastructure between clouds or Kubernetes clusters, including database migrations with limited downtime.
  • Experience designing disaster recovery strategies and conducting recovery exercises.
  • Cloud cost optimization and capacity planning experience.
  • Experience with DigitalOcean, Hetzner, or AWS.
  • Ability to read and troubleshoot JavaScript / TypeScript applications.
  • Experience operating financial or payment services with strict requirements around access control, auditing, reliability, and data integrity.



Benefits

  • Professional growth: support for courses, conferences, and English learning (up to 100% coverage).
  • Work-life fit: remote or hybrid format with flexible hours across international teams.
  • Paid leave: up to 20 vacation days +  8 company holidays + 5 personal days per year
  • Recognition programs: structured performance reviews and team awards.
  • Team culture: retreats in international locations (for example, company apartments in Cyprus).

Your scope spans the platform connecting cloud products and managed workloads, serverless execution, workflow automation, and Generative AI services.
This is an opportunity to shape how product teams build on the platform and how customers benefit from automation and AI. You will develop engineering leaders, influence architecture, and turn platform priorities into reliable software delivered at scale. The role combines clear ownership of people and delivery with active involvement in technical decisions.WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead multiple engineering teams and their leaders, with accountability for software development, QA outcomes, and delivery across Platform Core and Foundation.
  • Define and execute the technical roadmap with Product Management and peer engineering leaders, aligning platform investment with customer needs and product priorities.
  • Own the architecture and evolution of a secure, reliable, scalable cloud platform. Make shared services easier for product teams to adopt and build upon.
  • Lead the development of Function as a Service (FaaS), serverless execution, and workflow automation capabilities that enable reusable, event-driven product functionality.
  • Guide the delivery of Generative AI services and their integration into products and automated workflows, with clear expectations for quality, security, reliability, and cost.
  • Own engineering quality and production readiness in partnership with QA, security, and operations leaders. Use delivery and service performance measures to drive improvements.
  • Balance new capabilities, platform modernization, and operational needs through clear priorities, realistic capacity planning, and timely management of dependencies and risks.
  • Hire and develop engineering leaders and senior contributors. Build teams with clear ownership, strong technical judgment, and opportunities to grow.
  • Improve engineering effectiveness through automation, modern development and testing practices, and practical adoption of AI-assisted engineering.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, including 5+ years in engineering leadership.
  • Proven experience leading software development and QA organizations of 25+ people, with responsibility for multiple teams and their leaders.
  • A track record of building and evolving large-scale cloud platforms and delivering enterprise software from architecture through production operation.
  • Strong technical judgment in distributed systems, multi-tenant services, APIs, and cloud-native architecture. You can challenge designs and guide architectural decisions with senior engineers.
  • Practical understanding of FaaS/serverless platforms and workflow automation, including how execution, orchestration, and event-driven services fit together at scale.
  • Practical understanding of Generative AI services and their integration into production systems, including evaluation, data protection, reliability, and cost trade-offs.
  • Experience leading both software development and quality improvements, including test automation, CI/CD, release discipline, and production reliability.
  • The ability to translate strategy into achievable plans, manage capacity and dependencies, and communicate priorities and trade-offs clearly.
  • A record of hiring, coaching, and developing team leaders, and building effective partnerships across Product, engineering, QA, security, and operations.
  • A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


WHY THIS ROLE

You will shape a platform whose capabilities support multiple products and engineering teams. Your decisions will influence how quickly those teams can deliver, how reliably services operate, and how automation and AI become useful product capabilities.

The scope brings together an established cloud platform and new areas of development. It offers the opportunity to grow a strong engineering organization while making a direct contribution to the next stage of Acronis' platform


WHO WE ARE

A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is used by over 21,000 service providers to protect more than 750,000 businesses. 

Our corporate culture centers on innovation, accountability, and impact. We encourage our people to think boldly, challenge conventional approaches, and take ownership of outcomes. As a member of our global “A-Team,” you’ll operate in a high-growth, fast-paced environment where resilience, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement drive success. 

OUR INTERVIEW PRACTICES

To ensure a fair and genuine hiring process, candidates are expected to participate in interviews without the use of AI tools, automated prompts, or third-party assistance. Interviews are designed to assess individual skills, experience, and communication style, and we value authentic, real-time interaction.

Use of AI or external assistance during live interviews may result in disqualification. For roles where AI skills are being evaluated, permitted use of AI tools will be clearly communicated in advance. Candidates may be asked to disable virtual backgrounds or participate in in-person interviews. All employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of applicable criminal, education and identity background checks

Acronis is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

The US pay range for this position is $265,000–$380,000. This range reflects the minimum and maximum total target annual compensation for this role across all U.S. locations. The actual compensation offered at the start of employment is determined based on factors including, but not limited to, experience level, knowledge, skills, and geographic location. 

In addition to competitive compensation, this role includes a comprehensive benefits package featuring medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible spending accounts (FSA), disability and life insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan with company match, and a generous vacation policy.

With a mission-driven mindset and an entrepreneurial spirit, we are building something new and helping to harness data on a massive scale to make the world safer, stronger and more prosperous.

Between us, we have decades of experience in defence, operational intelligence, law enforcement, hyperscalers, big data processors and cyber security operations. We obsess about designing products that will change the way governments, international companies and non-profit organisations protect themselves from external threats and hostile adversaries

Position Overview: We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect to support the design and delivery of secure, scalable and resilient Microsoft Azure environments that support critical defence platforms. You will work with colleagues and stakeholders from a range of disciplines, based around the world, to shape mission-focused cloud strategies that meet strict security and performance requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain Azure Mission Environments using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or Bicep), aligned to the Cloud Adoption Framework and customer security requirements.
  • Design secure, performant solutions to integrate sensors and data with Mission Environments that scale, have resilience and cost efficiency.
  • Engineer and operate Azure networking, including:
    i. Hub-and-spoke and Virtual WAN topologies, VNet peering and route tables (UDRs) and vWAN
    ii. Azure Firewall, NSGs, Application Gateway / WAF and Front Door
    iii. Private Endpoints, Private Link and Private DNS zone design
    iv. Hybrid connectivity: site-to-site VPN, ExpressRoute and BGP routing
  • Design, configure and manage Cloudflare services, including:

    i. DNS management and zone configuration

    ii.Firewall rules, rate limiting, bot management and DDoS protection
    iii. Cloudflare Zero Trust / Access, Tunnels and secure application publishing
    iv. Certificate and TLS configuration, caching and performance tuning
    v. Managing Cloudflare configuration as code

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure, software solutions and platform deployments, including plan/apply workflows, approvals, testing and drift detection.
  • Implement and enforce governance through Azure Policy, management group hierarchy, RBAC, Privileged Identity Management and tagging and cost standards.
  • Implement platform security controls, including Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Key Vault, managed identities, diagnostic logging and Microsoft Sentinel integration.
  • Build observability with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Grafana and alerting, ensuring platforms are supportable and evidence is available for assurance.
  • Act as a Level 2/3 escalation point for complex platform, networking and connectivity issues, leading root cause analysis and permanent fixes.
  • Act as a point of contact for downstream data consumers of the platforms.
  • Lead integration of emerging capabilities – such as mobile platforms and zero-trust architectures – into legacy or hybrid estates.
  • Collaboratively work with wider Atreides Engineering teams on product updates and feedback.
  • Drive operational excellence through monitoring, capacity planning and cost control across cloud workloads.
  • Collaborate with Defence partners, third-party vendors and internal teams to ensure solutions meet programme requirements and security mandates.
  • Maintain architecture standards, patterns and run-books to support audit readiness, compliance and onboarding.

Required Qualifications:

  • Deep expertise in Azure architecture, infrastructure and engineering, including landing zone design and Azure Policy
  • A strong grounding in networking (VPNs, firewalls, routing, switching and ExpressRoute) and in security-by-design principles
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform and/or Bicep, including writing reusable modules, managing state and promoting changes safely across environments
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience supporting defence, intelligence or government clients, ideally in secure or classified environments
  • A Microsoft Azure certification, such as AZ-104 (Azure Administrator Associate) or AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect Expert), or equivalent hands-on experience

Eligibility Requirements

  • Right to work in Denmark: because of defence sector restrictions, candidates must be EU/EEA nationals or already hold a Danish work permit
  • Security clearance: you must be eligible for Danish SECRET clearance. Atreides will sponsor the vetting process for the successful candidate.

Nice to Have

  • Azure certifications: AZ-400 (Azure DevOps Engineer Expert), AZ-500 (Azure Security Engineer Associate) or AZ-700 (Azure Network Engineer Associate)
  • Experience using Python for infrastructure automation
  • CCNA or an equivalent networking qualification
  • Working proficiency in Danish
